thread:
morgan: Quick check: PEN tester wants a separate retest SLA and an evidence manifest with RBAC diffs for any changes during our mitigation window. We need to agree process.
priya: We should require a frozen baseline snapshot before any remediation starts, then a post-patch snapshot before retest. I can run snapshots and diff them.
ingrid: Agree. For audit: include CloudTrail plus app-level request_id traces. Also include a redaction manifest for any PII. Assessor requires unaltered ordering.
james: KMS plan: provide ephemeral KMS proxy role scoped to decrypt/test-key only. TTL 4h for retest; main window 6h. Will log key usage to a separate audit stream.
morgan: Good. Ops: how fast can we guarantee a retest slot after a severity-1/2 fix? We need SLA in the contract.
ops-oncall: We can hold a hot retest slot within 48 business hours for P1/P2 if infra capacity is available. Ops will reserve a candidate slot and mark it as "contingent" until fixes are submitted.
priya: Workflow I propose: 1) Pre-window baseline snapshot + checksum 2) Assessor runs tests 3) Findings filed to SEC ticket 4) Triage/patch 5) Post-patch snapshot + evidence bundle uploaded 6) Request retest slot (we have 48h hold) 7) Assessor verifies.
ingrid: Add that evidence bundles MUST include an md5 manifest and a README describing redactions and snapshot commands. Example manifest commands:
```
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-base.json gs://evidence-exports/eng-pen-175500/rbac-base.json
sha256sum rbac-base.json > rbac-base.sha256
```
james: Also log KV cache traces around the remediation because assessor flagged potential cache poisoning risk last time. Two short captures (before/after) should suffice.
morgan: Security-bot, please open a tracking ticket and set the retest hold flag. Also capture the SLA text for retest (48h for P1/P2).
security-bot: Created SEC-3250: "Retest SLA & evidence baseline for external assessment". Checklist added: baseline snapshot, post-patch snapshot, md5 manifest, ephemeral KMS role, KV traces, retention policy. Assigned priya and james.
ops-oncall: One ops caveat: if a fix requires infra changes that affect production topology, retest may need a staging window. We'll flag that in ticket.
priya: Noted. I'll attach the baseline snapshot here after I run it. Dry-run scheduled Tue 2026-03-02 15:00 UTC.
morgan: Thanks all. Keep updates in SEC-3250 thread. If immediate incident posture changes, escalate to #incidents and @ops-oncall.
